description: Resolves a product name or a category to tool slugs and hub page URLs. Use it to find the slug for a tool or to see which tools are covered in a category. Returns at most 25 results plus the full category list.

category.description: Optional category filter, for example "CRM" or "Compliance".

query.description: Name, partial name or keyword, for example "hub" or "CRM". Use an empty string to list a whole category.

name: search_tools
title: Search the tool list
